title: Useful Items
description: This mod adds features to vanilla items that have no purpose also adds some new items
body:
# **Useful Items(JAVA EDITION)**

**This mod has been discontinued and will no longer recevie updates. Insted some of the features in this mod will be in a new mod that will be relesed when i think it has enough content.**

This mod gives items that previously had few uses or no uses at all a chance to shine and be useful.

## Supported Loaders

*   Forge - **No**
*   NeoForge - **YES**
*   Fabric - **No**
*   Quilt - **No**

# Features in this mod


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

## Amethyst tools/ore

This mod adds a new use to **amethyst** by giving it a use in tools although not the strongest, they are **sharp and reliable**. Not only that, **we also made it into an ore**, so you can find it in more places than geodes, but the downside to mining it from the ore and not the geode is that it comes out unpolished, **Unpolished Amethyst Shard**, but **can be polished using a stone cutter**.

![Amethyst Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de5b3fb6e1d38b8c96e2842e98a62379c2102b4f_0.webp) ![Amethyst Editions ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e9e9bc594c8cb8d76e102308c66b68f632f1a13_0.webp)

## Craftable Trident

This mod makes it so you can craft a **Trident** **with 2 Prismarine Rods and 3 Quartz**.

![Trident Recipe ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f5ffb3b44078f756ff55a810e733e0f9fb3fd12_0.webp)

## Better Rotten Flesh

This mod adds new versions of **Rotten Flesh** to make it a viable food source. By placing Rotten Flesh on a campfire, it will become **Raw Flesh**, and you can then cook it in a **smoker, furnace, or just back on the campfire** to eat it cooked.

![Raw Flesh Cooking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8494cbe0b30947eb87369e3d4fd0248aa889cac9_0.webp)

## Craftable Upgrade Templates

This mod makes it so you can craft **Upgrade Templates**, although not useless, I thought it would be a nice edition to the mod, **also adding a new glue-like substance called Sculk Goo**.

![Upgrade Template Recipe ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/041f3ba9ca53d522399d632fb119a5d697683a1b_0.webp)

![Sculk Goo Recipe ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d405925a6351cd8d0813bce2d8ad5868bf0dabd_0.webp)

## Reinforced Tools

This mod adds a new item called **Prismarine rods** that can be crafted using a **smithing table** and is used to **reinforce every tool except for netherite tools**.

![Prismarine Rod Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1abc4327dbad06e2714019a698789593e37eb42.png)

![Reinforced Tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f6e7ab0d341641c90464487b7eaff844e7f1519.png)


</details>
